ACCOUNT SUPPORT
If you are having problems with your Ultima Online account and/or billing information, you can contact us through one of the following methods:

Visit http://eamembers.custhelp.com for our comprehensive self help guide

Account Assistance: (866) 543-5435 (option 2, then 1) for assistance with login, password, updating accounts, and other account related issues.

Billing Assistance: (866) 543-5435 (option 2, then 2) for purchase an additional accounts, game time codes, utilize an alternate payment option, registration problem/assistance, cancellation requests, or to reactivate. Monday through Friday, from 9:00am to 7:00pm CST & Saturday and Sunday, from 10:00am to 4:00pm CST

International: (512) 434-4670 (hit option 2)

Account Administration: For questions about banned, suspended or blocked accounts, please go here (NOTE: there is no phone support available for these issues).
